text_en: Now when the king was settled in his house, and the Lord had given him rest from all his enemies around him,
text_cn: 那时，君王住在宫殿里，上主赐他安享太平，不为四周仇敌所侵扰，

text_en: the king said to the prophet Nathan, “See now, I am living in a house of cedar, but the ark of God stays in a tent. ”
text_cn: 君王遂对纳堂先知说：“请看，我住在香柏木的宫殿里，而天主的约柜却在帐幕内。”

text_en: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that you have in mind; for the Lord is with you. ”
text_cn: 纳堂回答君王说：“你心内打算的，你全可照办！因为上主与你同在。”

text_en: But that same night the word of the Lord came to Nathan:
text_cn: 但是，当夜就有上主的话传于纳堂说：

text_en: Go and tell my servant David: Thus says the Lord : Are you the one to build me a house to live in?
text_cn: “你去告诉我的仆人达味，上主这样说：你要建筑一座殿宇给我居住吗？

text_en: I have not lived in a house since the day I brought up the people of Israel from Egypt to this day, but I have been moving about in a tent and a tabernacle.
text_cn: 我自从埃及领以色列子民上来那一天起，直到今日，从没有居住过殿宇，只随帐棚和会幕漂泊。

text_en: Wherever I have moved about among all the people of Israel, did I ever speak a word with any of the tribal leaders of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, saying, “Why have you not built me a house of cedar? ”
text_cn: 我与以色列子民同行时，我何尝向我立为牧养我民以色列的一个民长说过：你们为什么不为我建造一座香柏木的殿宇？”

text_en: Now therefore thus you shall say to my servant David: Thus says the Lord of hosts: I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep to be prince over my people Israel;
text_cn: 现在，你要对我的仆人达味说：“万军的上主这样说：是我拣选你离开牧场，离开放羊的事，作我民以色列的领袖。

text_en: and I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you; and I will make for you a great name, like the name of the great ones of the earth.
text_cn: 你不论到哪里去，我总是偕同你，由你面前消灭你的一切仇敌；我要使你成名，像世上出名的大人物；

text_en: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel and will plant them, so that they may live in their own place, and be disturbed no more; and evildoers shall afflict them no more, as formerly,
text_cn: 我要把我民以色列安置在一个地方，栽培他们，在那里久住，再也不受惊恐，再也不像先前受恶人的欺压，

text_en: from the time that I appointed judges over my people Israel; and I will give you rest from all your enemies. Moreover the Lord declares to you that the Lord will make you a house.
text_cn: 有如自从我为我民以色列立了民长以来一样；我要赐他们安宁，不受仇敌的骚扰。上主也告诉你：他要为你建立家室。

text_en: When your days are fulfilled and you lie down with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring after you, who shall come forth from your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
text_cn: 当你的日子满期与你祖先长眠时，我必在你以后兴起一个后裔，即你所生的儿子；我必巩固他的王权。

text_en: He shall build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
text_cn: 是他要为我的名建立殿宇；我要巩固他的王位直到永远。

text_en: I will be a father to him, and he shall be a son to me. When he commits iniquity, I will punish him with a rod such as mortals use, with blows inflicted by human beings.
text_cn: 我要作他的父亲，他要作我的儿子；若是他犯了罪，我必用人用的鞭，世人用的棍，来惩戒他；

text_en: But I will not take my steadfast love from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away from before you.
text_cn: 但我决不由他收回我的恩情，就如在你以前由撒乌耳收回我的恩情一样。

text_en: Your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before me; your throne shall be established forever.
text_cn: 你的家室和王权，在我面前永远存在，你的王位也永远坚定不移。”

text_en: In accordance with all these words and with all this vision, Nathan spoke to David.
text_cn: 纳堂便照这一切话，将整个启示告诉了达味。

text_en: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and said, “Who am I, O Lord God , and what is my house, that you have brought me thus far?
text_cn: 达味王就进去，端坐在上主面前说：“我主上主！我是谁？我的家族又算什么，你竟领我到了这个地步？

text_en: And yet this was a small thing in your eyes, O Lord God ; you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come. May this be instruction for the people, O Lord God !
text_cn: 我主上主！这在你眼中还以为太小，而你又说明了你仆人的家族未来的远景，并将此事显示给我这个人，我主上主！

text_en: And what more can David say to you? For you know your servant, O Lord God !
text_cn: 达味还能对你说什么？我主上主！你认识你的仆人。

text_en: Because of your promise, and according to your own heart, you have wrought all this greatness, so that your servant may know it.
text_cn: 你为了你的预许，按照你的心意，成就了这些伟大的事，为叫你的仆人认识清楚。

text_en: Therefore you are great, O Lord God; for there is no one like you, and there is no God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
text_cn: 我主上主！为此，你是伟大的，没有与你相似的；按照我耳所听的，除了你以外，没有别的神。

text_en: Who is like your people, like Israel? Is there another nation on earth whose God went to redeem it as a people, and to make a name for himself, doing great and awesome things for them, by driving out before his people nations and their gods?
text_cn: 世上又哪里有一个民族能比得上你的民族以色列？天主亲自去解救他们出来，作为自己的民族；为使他们成名，在你从埃及解救出来的人民前，行了大而可畏的奇事，驱除异民以及他们的神。

text_en: And you established your people Israel for yourself to be your people forever; and you, O Lord , became their God.
text_cn: 你将你民以色列永远坚定为你的民族，你，上主做了他们的天主。

text_en: And now, O Lord God, as for the word that you have spoken concerning your servant and concerning his house, confirm it forever; do as you have promised.
text_cn: 我主上主！现在，求你永远坚持你论及你的仆人和他的家室所说的话，按照你所说的履行吧！

text_en: Thus your name will be magnified forever in the saying, ‘The Lord of hosts is God over Israel’; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.
text_cn: 愿你的名永远受尊崇！人要说：万军的上主是以色列的天主！愿你仆人达味的家室，永远坚定在你面前！

text_en: For you, O Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have made this revelation to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house’; therefore your servant has found courage to pray this prayer to you.
text_cn: 万军的上主，以色列的天主！因为你曾启示你的仆人说：我要建立你的家室，因此，你的仆人才敢在你面前向你如此祈祷。

text_en: And now, O Lord God , you are God, and your words are true, and you have promised this good thing to your servant;
text_cn: 我主上主，惟有你是天主！你的话是真理，是你向你仆人应许了这些恩惠。

text_en: now therefore may it please you to bless the house of your servant, so that it may continue forever before you; for you, O Lord God , have spoken, and with your blessing shall the house of your servant be blessed forever. ”
text_cn: 求你如今就祝福你仆人的家室，使它永远在你面前存立，因为是你，我主上主所预许的，因此，你仆人的家室，必因你的祝福永远获得祝福。”
